title: MACHINES SHED ARMOUR
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 4, visible damage. A machine at full health and one about to die used to look the same; only the bar said so. Every machine now wears three bolted steel plates. Below three quarters health the first one breaks off, below half the second, below a quarter the last: each tumbles away in an arc, lands, lies on the ground for ten seconds and fades. So you can read how hurt a machine is from across the room, and a fight leaves scrap on the floor. Your teammate sees the same. Drawn only: health, armour and every number in the fight are exactly as before.
now: Machines wear armour plates that break off and tumble away as they take damage.
